assertions.content: A decree reducing the amount payable by an agriculturist debtor without granting the same relief to non-agriculturist co-debtors is objectionable if it creates unequal treatment.
assertions.speaker: The Court

assertions.content: The decree should have explicitly directed that payment by co-defendants 2 to 7 would release only their interest in the mortgaged property from sale.
assertions.speaker: The Court

assertions.content: The decree should have further directed that failure to pay by co-defendants 2 to 7 would result in the sale of the whole mortgaged property for the entire debt.
assertions.speaker: The Court

assertions.content: Although the decree lacked clear directions, reading it as a whole and considering the actual decision reveals its plain implication regarding the split of debt and security.
assertions.speaker: The Court

assertions.content: A subsequent agreement between parties during execution proceedings, releasing interests upon payment of specified amounts, proceeds on the assumption that the mortgage debt and security were split.
assertions.speaker: The Court

assertions.content: Defendant No. 1 cannot contend that the mortgage debt remained indivisible given the subsequent agreement and the plain implications of the decree.
assertions.speaker: The Court
